reported_result.status: DEVELOPMENT -- there is no frozen PMO paper table
reported_result.note: Every PMO number in this repo is development evidence recomputed from charged-call receipts. Nothing is a submitted result. The reproducer says so on every run.

environment.role: pinned production kernel for PMO -- NOT the same as T4's
environment.build: uv venv --python 3.11 <dir> && uv pip install --python <dir>/bin/python 'PyTDC==1.1.15' --no-deps && uv pip install --python <dir>/bin/python rdkit==2023.9.6 numpy==1.26.4 setuptools==69.5.1
environment.why_no_deps: PyTDC 1.1.15 pins rdkit>=2023.9.5,<2024.3.1, so installing it against 2024.3.5 is unsatisfiable. Production uses --no-deps plus a six shim, because PyTDC imports rdkit.six which modern RDKit does not ship.
environment.why_old_setuptools: setuptools>=81 removes pkg_resources, which tdc/metadata.py imports.
environment.the_image_holds_one_rdkit: So the PMO runtime -- oracle AND COMPOSE executor -- is 2023.9.6. A PMO number computed locally under 2024.3.5 needs a parity statement.
environment.reproduction_needs_none_of_this: tools/reproduce_pmo_tables.py needs numpy (for the production AUC) and optionally RDKit for the chemistry column. It never imports PyTDC and never calls an oracle.

preflight contract for the v1 scored runtime

reading_hazards.what: AUC is structurally depressed at short budgets
reading_hazards.why: top_auc trapezoids up from (0,0), so a run holding a constant top-ten level c scores c*(1 - frequency/(2*budget)): 20% removed at budget 250, 5% at 1000, 0.5% at the official 10000
reading_hazards.handling: the reproducer labels every sub-official budget and refuses to let a 250-call AUC be compared to a published 10k figure

reading_hazards.what: three oracles reward leaving the drug-like manifold
reading_hazards.why: gsk3b, jnk3 and drd2 are ML predictors over fingerprints; measured r(score, QED) = -0.705 on gsk3b and -0.750 on jnk3, and top molecules carry hypervalent iodine, trioxide chains and stacked hydrazines
reading_hazards.handling: the reproducer prints a chemistry column and flags these three tasks. Read the SMILES before banking a number.

reading_hazards.what: a ledger from a zero-oracle gate looks exactly like a scored run
reading_hazards.why: same schema, same task name, same oracle_protocol, but the scores come from a non-production scorer -- one such workspace holds a celecoxib best of 0.9167 against a real best of ~0.25
reading_hazards.handling: the reproducer excludes any ledger whose own committed report declares new_charged_oracle_calls == 0 or a zero-charged evidence_role, detected from that evidence rather than from the directory being named 'dryrun'

information_boundary.permitted: task-independent chemical prior, plus feedback COUNTED against the run's own budget. Online adaptation from scored observations is legitimate no-prescreen optimization.
information_boundary.prohibited: oracle internals, hidden component scores, uncounted same-task history, same-task winner routes, prescreened vocabularies. Computing a property on an uncounted candidate in order to select it IS objective evaluation.
information_boundary.note: A benchmark-declared target is a task INPUT only where the evaluated task actually supplies it. PMO black-box search supplies scalar feedback only, so handing the controller a reference structure evaluates reference-conditioned construction, not black-box discovery -- a different experiment that needs its own label.
